Select chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules associated with document CHEMBL3044971. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Require canonical_smiles to be present by using an INNER JOIN to compound_structures on molregno. Return distinct rows. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
